topics.title: Limits
topics.description: The foundation of calculus — understanding what a function approaches as input approaches a value.
objectives: Define the limit of a function informally and formally (epsilon-delta)
Evaluate limits algebraically and graphically
Apply limit laws to compute limits
Identify and classify discontinuities

topics.title: Derivatives
topics.description: The instantaneous rate of change of a function — defined as the limit of the difference quotient.
objectives: Define the derivative as a limit
Interpret the derivative as slope of tangent line and rate of change
Compute derivatives from the definition
Understand differentiability vs. continuity

topics.title: Differentiation Rules
topics.description: Systematic rules for computing derivatives: power, product, quotient, and chain rules.
objectives: Apply power, constant, and sum/difference rules
Use the product and quotient rules
Apply the chain rule to composite functions
Differentiate trigonometric, exponential, and logarithmic functions

topics.title: Integration
topics.description: The antiderivative and the definite integral as the area under a curve.
objectives: Define the indefinite integral as antiderivative
Compute definite integrals using Riemann sums
Apply basic integration rules
Understand the relationship between integration and area

topics.title: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
topics.description: Connects differentiation and integration, showing they are inverse operations.
objectives: State and prove both parts of the Fundamental Theorem
Use FTC Part 1 to differentiate integral functions
Use FTC Part 2 to evaluate definite integrals
Apply the theorem to solve applied problems

topics.title: Series and Sequences
topics.description: Infinite sequences, convergence, and series including Taylor and power series.
objectives: Define convergence and divergence of sequences
Apply convergence tests for series
Construct Taylor and Maclaurin series
Determine radius and interval of convergence
